notes: The input has no study/outcome/test locator or neutral description, so both target_match values remain null. Extracted the single-trace claim 4 explicitly identified by the named replication report and independently located it in the original paper. Original and replication use different ESS rounds. Original n is 25 country-level estimates (with 24,652 underlying women); replication k is 27 country-level estimates, not participant N. Original PDF text extraction renders mathematical glyphs imperfectly; quote normalizes equals and minus glyphs. Replication estimation console image was visually read and its relevant printed lines transcribed into the cached text. Replication effect and p retained from the main report, consistent with the estimation output.
